Title: The Bike

Cast

1. Tarun - 42, father
Look: blue t-shirt
2. Vrinda - 10, daughter
Look: yellow t-shirt

Places

1. The street - a road with trees

Things

1. Bike - a black motorbike

Scene 1: The street - evening

[Tarun gets on his bike, kicks up the stand and rides to the gate.]

Vrinda: "Papa, take me too!"

[Tarun parks the bike, puts it on its stand and gets off.]

Tarun: "Come on then, hop on!"
